notes.title: SteamVR compatibility issue fixed! -> Switch to FragmentVR beta branch
notes.content:
The source of the compatibility issue with the SteamVR beta branch has been found and fixed.

[h1]If you are on the SteamVR beta branch, then switch to the FragmentVR beta branch also.[/h1]

tags.bug: The source of the compatibility issue with the SteamVR beta branch has been found and fixed.

notes.title: Prerelease Patch!
notes.content:
Some quality of life features have been added in right in time for release:

-[b]Hide & Lock Corners toggle[/b]: Enabling this hides the corner logos and makes them unmovable
-[b]Opacity Slider[/b]: Opacity can now be manually set
